newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat edges ahead in mixed performance.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat edges ahead in mixed performance.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat firmed on Tuesday after Chicago's stronger tone overnight.
Market leader January 1998 was the only contract to trade, rising by A$2.50 a tonne to A$175.00 on the trade compared with Friday's closing settlement price. Eleven lots changed hands.
Settlement prices for near-term contracts fell by A$1.00-A$1.50 a tonne but gained by A$1.50-A$2.50 on more distant contracts.
The trade expects the Australian Wheat Board to reduce pool wheat pool prices by A$5.00-A$10.00 a tonne in its regular revision later on Monday.
